info.title: EventChat API
info.description: MVP REST contract. WebSocket CONNECT/SUBSCRIBE protocol is documented in docs/api/README.md.

post.summary: Upload one private attachment with multipart/form-data
post.description: The file part is named file. JPEG/PNG up to 5 MiB, supported documents up to 20 MiB; room quota 200 MiB. Returns READY. Uses extension allowlist and image signature checks; no antivirus or document parsing. A retry is a new upload; abandoned drafts expire within 24 hours.

415.description: Unsupported extension or invalid JPEG/PNG signature

parameters.description: When supplied, must be an active HOST session in this room. Its guest ID and nickname are snapshotted on finalization. Host token remains required. Missing session preserves legacy behavior with null confirmer identity.

delete.summary: Delete a proposal or withdraw a confirmed decision, retaining history

403.description: Missing, invalid, wrong-room, or revoked credentials

delete.description: Active session required. Host or author may delete an unconfirmed proposal; only host may withdraw a confirmed decision. Returns DELETED or WITHDRAWN. Idempotent retry. Room must be active and unexpired.

get.summary: Read a same-room discussion branch, including its root message

403.description: Missing, invalid, wrong-room, or revoked credentials

get.summary: List discussion branches across retained room history, newest activity first
get.description: Requires read access. Scans at most 50 grouped roots per page. Invalid or expired roots are omitted; cursor advances over scanned groups. Apply cursor after grouping to prevent duplicate branches. Empty branches are not persisted.

403.description: Missing, invalid, wrong-room, or revoked session

CreateRoom.description: Omit both TTL fields for 1440 minutes. Send at most one TTL field.

Message.description: Send nonblank body or 1-4 READY attachmentIds. A retry with attachments must preserve body, reply and ordered attachmentIds. Message responses/history/WS include attachments as AttachmentMetadata snapshots.

threadRootId.description: Main-chat root message ID. Omit for main chat. Only text replies in a branch; root must be a published same-room TEXT message with no parent branch.

sourceSpinId.description: Optional, host only. Server validates room ownership, appends actual spin result to text (context), and deduplicates by spin ID including deleted/withdrawn decisions.

data.description: Payload documented per endpoint in docs/api/README.md.

revision.description: Monotonic result revision; counts can decrease.

confirmedByNickname.description: Authenticated confirmer nickname snapshot, separate from creatorNickname. Null for legacy records or host-token-only clients.

confirmedByGuestId.description: Authenticated confirmer guest ID snapshot. Retained after withdrawal.

threadReplyCount.description: Total saved replies, not a delta; counts on main messages are batched.
